bead.title: Persist hybrid request-id replay across restart
bead.description: Close the committed-but-unreturned request-id gap for objectlog/hybrid. Current generic ComposedBackend keeps push request-id replay in an in-memory QueueIdempotencyCache, while SqliteProjectionStore has durable request-id tables that are not populated by object-log apply. Implement durable recovery for request-id pushes under hybrid: either persist equivalent idempotency rows during HybridProjectionStore::apply from CommandEnvelope::request_id and PushCommand body, or rebuild the generic cache during recovery by scanning retained object-log entries and queue definitions. Same request_id and same body must replay original item ids after restart; same request_id with a different body must return RequestIdConflict; uncommitted requests must be fresh. Out of scope: vectorized commit-transition idempotency beyond existing supported surfaces.
bead.acceptance:
1. cargo test -p pqueue-sqlite hybrid_request_id -- --nocapture passes.
2. cargo test -p pqueue-objectlog hybrid_request_id -- --nocapture passes if the tests live there, otherwise cargo test -p pqueue-server hybrid_request_id -- --nocapture passes.
3. cargo test -p pqueue-conformance request_id -- --nocapture passes.
4. cargo fmt --check passes.
